subject: Orchestration Hub - regional SI data path & residency constraints
messages:
From: Lars Petersen <lars@vectra-si.dk>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Orchestration hub — quick alignment on EU / APAC data path

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the intro last week — our leadership asked us to map the SI-side requirements for an orchestration hub that EdgeBridge and Vectra SI would operate in APAC and EU markets. We sketched a short inventory and have three immediate questions before we lock a pilot scope:

1) For EU customers, do you require a per-customer on-prem enclave (air-gapped) or is VPC + regional compute sufficient for initial certification?
2) What artifacts will Redwood accept for the data residency statement (SOC2 + signed MSA addendum vs. local on-prem attestations)?
3) Latency SLOs: are there preferred sequence-length baselines we should use for throughput guarantees (e.g., 512 vs 2048 tokens)?

I attached a first-pass inventory (regional-data-inventory.csv) and a draft architecture diagram (si-architecture-draft.pdf). Can we set a 30-min sync with your partner/sales/security leads this week?

Best,
Lars Petersen
Partnerships Lead — Vectra SI
+45 23 45 67 89

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Lars Petersen <lars@vectra-si.dk>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orchestration hub — quick alignment on EU / APAC data path

Lars — thanks for the clear questions and the attachments. Short answers up front so we can prep the sync:

1) For pilot customers we typically accept VPC + regional compute if customers sign the residency addendum. On-prem enclaves are supported but usually required only for regulated customers (gov, finance).
2) We accept SOC 2 + a signed MSA addendum for most EU customers; for localized audits we will accept on-prem attestation documents as a follow-on deliverable.
3) Latency SLOs: baseline guidance: target 512 tokens for interactive SLAs (p95 < 250ms on Dedicated); for batch inference 2048 token baselines are common. We'll bring runtime folks to confirm kernel profiles.

30-min sync works. Marissa/Ben — can you join a Friday slot? Lars — propose a time and I will book.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Manager, EMEA — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lars Petersen <lars@vectra-si.dk>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 08:21:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Orchestration hub — quick alignment on EU / APAC data path

Lars / Rafael,

Thanks — I reviewed the attachments. A couple of follow-ups from the security/compliance lens before the call:

- For the residency addendum, we need the customer-facing language to include retention windows, deletion procedures, and the KMS boundaries (who holds CMK). If Vectra will host keys on behalf of customers we need to add key custody clauses.
- The architecture diagram needs clearer network flow: which traffic terminates in customer VPC vs. partner-managed subnet. Please update the diagram to annotate where logs, audit trails, and access requests are stored.
- We should include a simple checklist for Evidence of Isolation (VM snapshots, attestation logs, or HSM audit records).

I'll prep a short MMP (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) with requirements, owner, and acceptance criteria so we can agree on a pilot MVP. Rafael — if we want to keep the pilot lightweight, call out 2 customers (one EU, one APAC) and one non-production on-prem test.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships & Alliances — Redwood Inference
From: Lars Petersen <lars@vectra-si.dk>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Amiya Reddy <amiya@accentium.co>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 10:34:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Orchestration hub — quick alignment on EU / APAC data path

Marissa — appreciate the checklist pointer, that's helpful. Quick clarifications from our security lead (Amiya is cc'd):

- Vectra will not hold customer keys; we propose customer-managed KMS with EdgeBridge-managed HSM for attestation. That should satisfy KMS boundary concerns.
- For network flows: we can annotate termination points; simplest model is: customer VPC -> partner ingress gateway (EdgeBridge) -> partner-managed processing cluster in region -> Redwood model endpoints. We'll mark where logs are mirrored to customer audit buckets.
- Attestation: we can provide VM snapshot schedules and HSM audit exports as evidence.

I'll update the diagram and the inventory and share the updated files before the call. Proposed times: Fri 18:00 UTC or Mon 09:00 SGT — Rafael, which works?

Best,
Lars
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lars Petersen <lars@vectra-si.dk>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 15:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Orchestration hub — quick alignment on EU / APAC data path

Adding pricing and operational notes so expectations are aligned for the pilot:

- Dedicated capacity for regionally isolated pilot (1 GPU pool per region) estimate: $12k/mo per region for committed baseline (3-month minimum).
- Integration effort: ~4-6 engineer-weeks (partner + Redwood runtime engineers) to wire KV caching and regional routing; travel costs not included.
- Optional on-prem enclave readiness: engineering readiness assessment ~2 weeks, separate SOW.

If that fits your planning, we'll include budget lines in the mutual-action-plan.xlsx. Rafael — happy to surface a lightweight discount for pilot customers via an introductory credit line.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

- The proposed customer-managed KMS model is acceptable. We'll append a short KMS flow to the architecture diagram and provide HSM audit export examples.
- For evidence of isolation, we'll include snapshot retention policies and an attestation template that legal can sign.
- We'll take the 18:00 UTC slot on Friday for the kickoff — Lars will send the calendar invite and we'll attach the revised attachments (mutual-action-plan.xlsx + updated diagram).
